'''Aquaris''' was an inhabited [[Waterworld/Legends|aquatic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Cvetaen system/Legends|Cvetaen system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]]. Devoid of any landmasses, the planet was one large ocean.

==History==
[[File:Demonsquid-CSW8.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A [[demonsquid]] on Aquaris]]
Discovered during the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]], the ocean world suffered a devastating natural disaster circa [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]; however, the world's native [[Sentience/Legends|sapients]], the [[Chuhkyvi]], were evacuated by a benevolent alien species to [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]] before the catastrophe could wipe them out.<ref name="TEGPM" />

Just within the borders of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]], Aquaris eventually was left unoccupied and uncontested during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Eventually the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] laid claims to this area of space, holding onto it throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the conflict, renegade [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] scientist, [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]], was believed by the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] to have made a stopover here before continuing on to exile on [[Dorumaa]].<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Alaric (Sephi)|Alaric]] the whole sector including this planet, left the Republic and joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Aquaris Freeholders/Legends|Aquaris Freeholders]] began to seek liberation from the Empire, offering the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] access to their expansive [[Freeholders' Base|underwater base]]. Accessible through a retractable surface [[Aquaris launching platform|landing platform]], the Freeholders survived on the planet by piloting submersible [[aqua-skimmer]]s to hunt the planet's marine wildlife. As members of the Rebel Alliance, many Freeholders left the world to attack the Empire holdings.<ref name="TEGPM" />

Not playing much more of a role in the Civil War, the planet was [[Battle of the Cvetaen system|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Fauna==
Among the most dangerous aquatic creatures in Aquaris' oceans were the enormous [[demonsquid]], which were eight-tentacled mollusks with large jaws beneath a clump of arms. The [[Gnooroop/Legends|gnooroop]] traveled in dense schools that could stretch up to ten kilometers long.<ref name="TEGPM" />
